description: Header file declaring functions for Linux interface statistics collection related to wireless LAN (WLD). It includes function prototypes for retrieving interface, VAP, radio, and VLAN stats.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getInterfaceStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a specified network interface.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getVapStats
methods.description: Retrieves VAP (Virtual Access Point) statistics for a given access point.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getAllVapStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for all VAPs associated with a radio.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getAllEpStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for all endpoints associated with a radio.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_acculumateUpperVlansStats
methods.description: Accumulates statistics for upper VLANs on a given interface.
